reply_body: You signed up with the trial and weren't expecting the full plan charge that showed up today — I understand why that's frustrating. Our billing team will review your subscription record and exactly how the trial rolled over into the paid plan. If you'd also like the plan stopped so it doesn't continue, tell me and that will be arranged. You'll hear back on this shortly.
summary: User took a low-cost trial, says the full plan charge was taken without agreement, and wants it returned.
